note: State park campground in the Little River canyon 3 mi south of Mendocino, east of Hwy 1 from the beach. The lower loop and the river spur sit on the canyon floor under redwoods; the larger upper loop is on the bench above. A temporary 10-ft-wide single-lane bridge reaches the sites east of the river, and trailers must turn around past it; large trailers should check it first. Sites 26-30 take no RVs. Pay showers. The 9 hike-in environmental sites are closed. --Claude
summary: Van Damme: open; winter only sites 1-13 FCFS (14+ closed for the season). $45, 63 standard sites, pads mostly 27 ft (site 7 35 ft; 49 of 65 web units 23 ft+; 26-30 no RVs), 30-night max, pay showers, dump. Temporary 10-ft single-lane bridge east of the river (caution for large trailers, not a drop). Creekside KEPT for lower loop / spur. Phone 937-5804 -> 937-0851.
flags: ACCESS (reported, not a drop candidate): 'a temporary single lane bridge ... measuring 10 feet in width and 53 feet in length. The bridge configuration does not allow for a straight on and straight off approach or exit'; trailers must U-turn past it to reach the group camp, sites 31-74 'and in some cases sites 19 and 20'; 'If you are traveling with a large trailer it is recommended ... walk into the park to look at the bridge'. It is a caution, not 'not recommended', and a 23-ft motorhome ~8 ft 1 in with mirrors fits a 10-ft bridge; sites 1-13 (and 14-18 west of the crossing) do not use it. Caveat in the note.
STATUS/SEASON: 'campsites 14-92 are closed for the season campsites 1-13 remain open for first come first serve camping' (read 2026-11-27). Year-round with winter FCFS on 1-13.
PHONE: 707-937-5804 (Sonoma-Mendocino District Office) -> (707) 937-0851 (the park's own number on parks.ca.gov).

WATERFRONT: stored 'creekside' (not --AWH) KEPT, low confidence. Little River is a small coastal stream (well under 30 m). 3DEP puts the canyon floor ~100 m wide at 4.3-4.9 m with the channel ~2 m lower; the lower loop (sites 1-13, RC point 39.27496,-123.78789) and the spur (14-30, 39.27670,-123.78318) are on that floor, and the park map draws sites 1-6, 12-13 and 22-30 along the river. Under canopy, but creekside needs only an easy walk down (~2 m over a short wooded bank). The upper loop (31-74, ~44 of the sites) is on the bench ~50 m above: not waterfront. No per-site distances (redwood canopy hides pads on Esri). If the reviewer wants named-site proof beyond the schematic map, default down to not waterfront.
SITES: stored 63 kept; RC lists 65 web units (13 lower, 12 spur, 40 upper). Pads: 27 ft on most; 35 on site 7; 21 on 11, 12, 18, 33, 36, 41, 53, 57, 63, 73, 74; sites 26-30 20 ft, no trailers/RVs.
NOT A SPLIT: the three loops are 200-500 m apart on one park road from one entrance.
